risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly addresses cybersecurity risks with Board-level oversight through the Corporate Risk and Sustainability Committee. The committee includes directors with cybersecurity expertise and receives regular updates from the Chief Information Officer. The severity remains high due to potential operational impact from security breaches.

risks.title: Regulatory and Environmental Compliance
risks.score_rationale: Company is subject to government and environmental regulations that impact operations. The company does not characterize these as major risks, but compliance costs and operational constraints are material considerations in the chemicals and materials industry.

risks.title: Market Competition
risks.score_rationale: Westlake operates in highly competitive global markets for performance materials and housing products. Recent industry deterioration in chlorovinyls and epoxy segments demonstrates exposure to competitive and commodity price pressures.

risks.title: Key Person Risk
risks.score_rationale: James Chao (age 78) serves as Senior Chairman and Albert Chao (age 76) serves as Executive Chairman following recent succession changes in July 2024. Both founders remain actively involved but represent concentration of leadership among aging principals. Succession planning in place but execution risk remains.

risks.title: Litigation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company indicates involvement in various legal proceedings incidental to business operations but does not expect material adverse effects. Antidumping and countervailing duty investigations in epoxy resin trade represent emerging regulatory risk rather than traditional litigation.
